svg.aria-label: The same eight-second motion and velocity impulse at three seconds. Position, applied acceleration with ±1 m/s² bounds, and accumulated normalized stage costs are shown. MPC remeasures and replans every 0.2 seconds; the open-loop comparison executes its original plan without responding to the disturbance.
